Understanding your result

Adult BMI is a screening measure—not a diagnosis. Health professionals interpret it alongside waist size, blood pressure, health history, fitness, and other factors.

What happens after you calculate?

Your result card explains where your BMI sits on the standard adult scale and shows the weight range corresponding to a BMI of 18.5–24.9 at your height. It is designed to prompt informed, supportive next steps, not to prescribe a treatment.

Medical note

Adult BMI categories do not apply to children or adolescents. BMI may be less representative during pregnancy, in competitive athletes, and in people with unusually high muscle mass. Seek individual advice for unexplained weight change or health concerns.
